title: Rotenoids from the Roots of Vicia faba L. (Fabaceae): Structural Characterization, Cytotoxic Effects, and Molecular Docking.
authors: Sipoloni, Victor Menezes; Silva-Silva, Joao Victor; Ferreira, Elthon G; Lee, Eric Yoshitaka; Junior, Joao Marcos Batista; Uemi, Miriam; de Medeiros, Livia Soman; Jimenez, Paula C; Veiga, Thiago A M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蚕豆根中鱼藤酮类化合物的结构鉴定、细胞毒活性及与HIF1A等蛋白的分子对接，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The chemical study of the ethanolic extract from the roots of Vicia faba led to the isolation of two isoflavonoids, alfalone and 8-O-methylretusine, as well as a mixture of rotenoids, including clitoriacetal and clitoriacetal B, the latter of which is reported for the first time. These compounds were characterized through nuclear magnetic resonance and vibrational circular dichroism spectroscopies, and density functional theory calculations. The rotenoid mixture exhibited cytotoxic activity against HCT-116, MCF-7, and 501Mel cell lines, while showing no significant toxicity to NIH/3T3 cells. The predictive analysis identified several shared therapeutic targets across colorectal cancer, breast cancer, and melanoma. Key sites, including hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha (HIF1A), estrogen receptor, heat shock protein HSP 90-beta, and heat shock protein HSP 90-alpha, were highlighted for their critical roles in tumor progression and therapeutic resistance. Notably, clitoriacetal demonstrated an affinity for HIF1A, suggesting its involvement in the observed antitumor effects, likely through modulation of the HIF1A pathway. These findings underscore the potential of V. faba root-derived compounds as promising candidates for targeted cancer therapies.
abstract_zh: 对蚕豆（Vicia faba）根部乙醇提取物的化学研究分离出两种异黄酮类化合物，即alfalone和8-O-甲基瑞替辛（8-O-methylretusine），以及包括clitoriacetal和clitoriacetal B在内的鱼藤酮类混合物，其中后者为首次报道。这些化合物通过核磁共振和振动圆二色光谱以及密度泛函理论计算进行了表征。该鱼藤酮类混合物对HCT-116、MCF-7和501Mel细胞系表现出细胞毒活性，而对NIH/3T3细胞未显示显著毒性。预测分析识别出结直肠癌、乳腺癌和黑色素瘤之间的多个共享治疗靶点。关键位点，包括缺氧诱导因子1-α（HIF1A）、雌激素受体、热休克蛋白HSP 90-β和热休克蛋白HSP 90-α，因其在肿瘤进展和治疗耐药中的关键作用而受到关注。值得注意的是，clitoriacetal对HIF1A表现出亲和力，提示其可能通过调节HIF1A通路参与观察到的抗肿瘤效应。这些发现强调了蚕豆根部来源化合物作为靶向癌症治疗有前景候选物的潜力。
